HMLR_S3_DRAFT_SERVICE_ADDRESS_BLANK
The address-for-service panel is left blank at draft-approval stage.
HMLR_S3_TRANSFER_WORDING_CONSISTENT
Chosen transfer-panel terminology should be used consistently.
HMLR_S3_MONEY_OPTION
A wholly monetary price normally uses the first consideration option.
HMLR_S3_PART_EXCHANGE_OPTION
Part-exchange transactions may retain a second consideration option.
HMLR_S3_TRUST_BLANK
The declaration-of-trust panel is left blank at draft-approval stage.
HMLR_S3_ADDITIONAL_PROVISION_SCOPE
The additional-provisions panel covers easements, rentcharges, covenants, agreements and declarations.
HMLR_S3_DEFINITIONS_CERTAINTY
Definitions should be included where necessary to make the transfer certain.
HMLR_S3_NO_REDEFINE_PROPERTY
The prescribed term Property should not be redefined.
HMLR_S3_ALL_EASEMENTS_IN_DRAFT
The approved draft should set out all easements that may be granted or reserved.
HMLR_S3_EASEMENT_PLAN_IF_NEEDED
A plan reference should define an easement area that words cannot describe adequately.
HMLR_S3_CONDITIONAL_EASEMENTS_BRACKETED
Easements applying only to some units should be bracketed in the draft.
HMLR_S3_REMOVE_INAPPLICABLE_EASEMENT
An individual transfer should omit draft easements that do not apply to that unit.
HMLR_S3_APPURTENANT_CONFIRMATION
HM Land Registry can confirm registrability of granted easements when title to grant is shown.
HMLR_S3_NO_GRANT_WORDS_REQUIRED
Rights listed under proper subheadings do not require separate words of grant or reservation.
HMLR_S3_ESTATE_RENTCHARGES
Estate rentcharges remain capable of creation despite the general statutory prohibition.
HMLR_S3_RENTCHARGE_PURPOSE
Estate rentcharges can fund services, maintenance, repairs or insurance for affected land.
HMLR_S3_RENTCHARGE_REGISTER
An estate rentcharge must be registered and noted to be effective at law.
HMLR_S3_RENTCHARGE_SPECIFIC_APPLICATION
Substantive rentcharge registration requires a specific application and prescribed fee.
HMLR_S3_RESTRICTIVE_BURDEN
HM Land Registry notes the burden of restrictive covenants in the register.
HMLR_S3_RESTRICTIVE_BENEFIT_NOT_ENTERED
The statutory scheme does not provide for entering the benefit of restrictive covenants.
HMLR_S3_POSITIVE_INDEMNITY_NOTE
Positive and indemnity covenants relating to the estate are usually noted in the proprietorship register.
HMLR_S3_STANDARD_RESTRICTION_TP
A standard restriction may be requested in TP1 or TP2 additional provisions.
HMLR_S3_NONSTANDARD_RX1
A non-standard restriction must be requested using form RX1.
HMLR_S3_DRAFT_RX1_REVIEW
A draft RX1 can be reviewed with the draft transfer or lease.
HMLR_S3_BOUNDARY_DECLARATIONS
Declarations about boundaries may be accepted.
HMLR_S3_DECLARATION_NOT_EXCLUSION
A declaration should not be used for a corporeal exclusion.
HMLR_S3_EXECUTION_SCHEDULE9
Proposed execution should follow a form in Schedule 9 of the Land Registration Rules 2003.
HMLR_S3_ATTORNEY_POWER_FILE
A certified power of attorney can be lodged with the draft and retained on file.
HMLR_S3_ATTORNEY_ID_FORMS
Attorney identity evidence uses form ID1 or ID2 as appropriate.
HMLR_S3_ATTORNEY_LETTER_12M
The HM Land Registry attorney-identity letter is valid for 12 months.
HMLR_S3_UTILITIES_RIGHTS_OFTEN_UNNEEDED
Specific purchaser utility-service rights may be unnecessary because statutory providers have their own powers.
HMLR_S3_DRAINAGE_DIFFERENT
The guidance's utility-right simplification does not extend automatically to drainage rights.
HMLR_S3_MINERALS_SEVERANCE
Excepting mines and minerals can sever them from the surface land.
HMLR_S3_MINERALS_NEW_TITLE
Retained mines and minerals may be registered under a new title before surface removals.
HMLR_S3_MINERALS_AP1
A minerals-retention registration uses form AP1 with relevant chargee consent.
HMLR_S3_LEASE_DATE_BLANK
The draft prescribed-clauses lease date is left blank.
HMLR_S3_LEASE_TENANT_BLANK
The tenant identity field is left blank in the draft prescribed-clauses lease.
HMLR_S3_LEASE_TRUST_BLANK
The draft lease declaration-of-trust clause is left blank.
HMLR_S3_LEASE_RESTRICTION_LR13
A prescribed-clauses lease can request a standard restriction in clause LR13.
HMLR_S3_COPIES_IN_BATCHES
Developers should request official copies and title-plan inspection certificates in batches.
HMLR_S3_NO_INITIAL_BULK_COPIES
Official copies should not be ordered as one bulk request at the outset.
HMLR_S3_LATER_BATCH_UPDATES
Later batches can reflect entries and plan references created by earlier sales.
HMLR_S4_PURCHASER_SCOPE
The plot-sales supplement explains how purchasers can verify the plot and related rights within the developer's title.
HMLR_S4_OFFICIAL_SEARCH_SCOPE
The supplement covers official searches, charge discharges, restrictions and leasehold issues.
HMLR_S4_CERTIFIED_COPIES_ONLY
HM Land Registry applications need certified copies rather than original supporting deeds.
HMLR_S4_SCANNED_DESTROYED
Documents sent with applications are destroyed after scanning.
HMLR_S4_UPLOAD_CERTIFICATION
Uploaded scans can be certified as true copies using the available certification statement.
HMLR_S4_REGISTER_COPY_ALWAYS
A purchaser should always inspect an official copy of the developer's register.
HMLR_S4_REGISTER_CLASS_TITLE
The developer's register reveals the class of title offered.
HMLR_S4_REGISTER_BURDENS
The developer's register reveals burdens affecting the land.
HMLR_S4_FENCE_PLAN_ALIGNMENT
Plot-boundary fences should match the transfer or lease plan.
HMLR_S4_SURVEYOR_IF_DOUBT
A competent land surveyor may be needed where boundary positioning is uncertain.
HMLR_S4_CONFIRM_PLOT_IN_TITLE
The purchaser must confirm that the plot lies in the developer's title.
HMLR_S4_CHECK_TITLEPLAN_REFERENCES
The purchaser should identify title-plan references affecting the plot.
HMLR_S4_PRE_COMPLETION_CHECK
Immediately before completion, the purchaser should confirm the plot remains in title.
HMLR_S4_PENDING_APPLICATION_CHECK
The pre-completion check should identify prior pending applications.
HMLR_S4_ADVERSE_ENTRY_CHECK
The pre-completion check should identify new adverse register entries.
HMLR_S4_FORM_CI_IN_TITLE
Form CI certifies that the described plot falls within the registered title.
HMLR_S4_FORM_CI_COLOUR_REFERENCE
Form CI reports whether a colour or other title-plan reference affects the plot.
HMLR_S4_SEARCH_PROTECTS_CHARGE
A chargee's official search can protect both the charge and the dependent transfer or lease.
HMLR_S4_FRESH_SEARCH_PRIORITY
A later official search certificate creates a fresh priority period.
HMLR_S4_TWO_TITLES_ONE_SEARCH
Two developer title numbers may be included on one search where a plot spans both.
